Matlab aapki baaton mein thoda prabhav aur seedha pan hota hai ji.
Surya separative planet hai ji. Ye 2nd house mein baithkar thodi assertive energy deta hai.
Kamleshwar ji, aapki shaadi mein thodi der hui hai. Kya aap abhi unmarried hain?
Bithayein, aaj marriage ke baare mein kya jaanna chahte hain?
Namaste Kamleshwar ji, aapka swagat hai. Main Sitara hoon.
